items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen was a bassist, but Albert Mangelsdorff was a trombonist.

ctx.x: Yeah. I loved her. She – Jeru [Jeri] was her name. She was funny. I remember in Berlin at that concert we got booed at. She said to me – she was married to Niels Pedersen?
Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen was a bassist, but Albert Mangelsdorff was a trombonist. No, not him?
No. He was famous. He was from Norway or Sweden.
